articles.title: Nvidia CEO Huang quits company he co-founded, led for 3 decades. Shares slump
articles.snippet: CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO after Huang steps down immediately as president, chief executive and board member, as shares tumble.

articles.title: UK bank Griffin raises $20 million to expand into stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: The Series B funding round, led by Octagon Partners valued the London-based company at more than $100 million.

articles.title: MSCI is dropping Strategy from its index, and the exclusion could hit its bitcoin-buying machine
articles.snippet: MSCI’s decision to exclude Strategy from its equity indexes could hamper the company’s ability to buy more bitcoin, according to some analysts.

articles.title: Strategy stock sheds 5% amid MSCI index removal, Bitcoin sell-off
articles.snippet: Strategy shares declined Thursday following MSCI’s decision to remove the company from its indexes, as Bitcoin also fell amid a broader crypto market decline.

articles.title: US Justice Department, business groups and DeFi firms challenge Illinois crypto tax
articles.snippet: Industry groups argued in court filings that Illinois’ crypto tax, which applies even when a transaction yields no profit, could raise compliance costs and violate federal law.
